title: QAtlas editorial plan
description: One decision object per discovered candidate paper, ordered as in candidates.json.

paper_id.description: QAtlas paper id as listed in candidates.json.

decision.description: supplement: extend an existing entry; new_entry: new page in an existing category; new_category: new category plus its first entry; skip: off-topic, duplicate, or insufficient evidence.

target_path.description: Wiki page to create or modify. Required unless decision is skip.

category_path.description: Category directory involved. Required for new_category; optional otherwise.

proposed_title.description: Chinese entry title. Required unless decision is skip.

reason.description: Why this decision was made, referencing the wiki index.

quantum_dot_scope.description: Whether the paper directly studies quantum dots, directly enables quantum-dot experiments, or is out of scope.

quantum_dot_relevance.description: Relevance score to a quantum-dot encyclopedia. Active decisions require at least 0.7.

quantum_dot_connection.description: A concrete explanation of how the paper connects to quantum-dot physics or experiments.

formula_topics.description: Formulas from the paper that the generated page must explain.

figure_numbers.description: fig_no values from figures.json to reuse as page figures.

links_to_update.description: Existing pages whose backlinks or sections must be updated.
